quality.source: Mattilsynet, Slakting av oppdrettet laksefisk (salmon and trout together, tonnes as reported by the farmers)

capacity.note: Estimated biomass per farmer = capacity of its active sites x the filling rate of the production area (register biomass / capacity of all active sites); a site shared by two farmers is split equally.
capacity.source: Fiskeridirektoratet, Akvakulturregisteret (daily dump) · BarentsWatch site status · Biomasseregisteret

weekly.source: Norges sjømatråd (Norwegian Seafood Council), weekly statistics; customs data via Statistics Norway. Norwegian exports only, FOB Norwegian border.
